data.narrative:
Eikon Therapeutics is a Series B-stage biotech company founded by Luke Lavis, Eric Betzig, Robert Tjian, and Xavier Darzacq, currently valued at $539M post-money following $1.1B+ in total capital raised. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage biotech and health companies, with three direct peers at adjacent stages: Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B Series C), and New Limit ($3.1B Series C).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implies a forward valuation of $1.0B. Peer-median anchoring across the three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields $3.8B, with a range of $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp P/S anchoring (median 6.6x across sector peers) cannot be applied due to unavailable revenue data. Synthesizing both applicable methods produces a triangulated range of $870M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.4B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty in peer selection: the peer-median method pulls substantially higher, driven by later-stage comparable valuations. Key uncertainties include clinical-stage progression risk, the applicability of Series C peer valuations to a Series B context, and undisclosed revenue or commercial metrics that would enable public-comp calibration.
